changes.title: New islands
items: New islands sparkle on the sea chart until you've sailed there, and the compass pin points at them
After a night, the pointer leads you to the map table while there's an island you haven't visited, and only then to bed

changes.title: Whole cull
items: Smoother on foot in thick woods: the graphics card no longer draws treetops that are fading away round the witch twice over

changes.title: Ko idle
items: Knocked out, the animals you were carrying now stay near where they were dropped (dancing, if it's a party area) instead of walking home, so you can go back and pick up their runes
